spec.title: Output relations for an object parameter's field (H5's rest): the same verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
spec.description: A regression check's correspondence (step H5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md) may now give an output relation for an object parameter's field as the calls leave it, field:p.cents, compared in place of the input equation about that path (which still makes the previous object). Over the price kernel in lib/tests/heap.rs (Price(long cents) before, Price(long dollars, int cents) now, related by old.p.cents == new.p.dollars * 100 + new.p.cents), a raise that now rounds up to whole dollars is refuted under the equation alone (differs field:p) and verified under the relation new.p.dollars * 100 + new.p.cents - old.p.cents >= 0 && ... < 100; the exact raise is verified under it; the defect that drops the carry is refuted in field:p.cents with a witness run on a JVM. These run inline on the own checker. This job runs the ignored test that repeats the four under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm, where JBMC checks the same harness (the relation compared in its bytecode).
spec.expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both engines: rounded without the relation Violation, rounded and after under it Verified, defect under it Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM (counterexample.jvm set).
